[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-sn[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Fix xprompt free-text argument parsing (`[[...]]` text blocks)[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Free-text xprompt arguments survive prose that contains `]]`, `+`, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]commas, and apostrophes; the `[[...]]` text-block rule has one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]authoritative definition that every Python and Rust argument [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]scanner shares; and a failed xprompt argument binding reports [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]itself once, accurately, instead of leaking a stray error from a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]best-effort diagnostic and then failing later with an unrelated [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]directive error.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/xprompt_text_block_args.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-sn[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-sn/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Canonical text-block closing rule in the Python scanners[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]grammar: close a `[[...]]` text block at the first `]]` in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]argument-terminator position instead of the first `]]` anywhere, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]apply that rule to all three Python argument scanners.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop round-tripping shorthand free text through `[[...]]`[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]shorthand[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]shorthand: bind `#name: text`, `#name:: text`, and `#name(args): text` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]payloads structurally during expansion so user prose is never [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]re-serialized into source syntax and re-lexed.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Silence and sharpen expansion-failure reporting[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]diagnostic[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]diagnostic: keep the best-effort unresolved-reference pre-scan from [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]printing a fatal expansion error it then swallows, and make an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]argument-binding failure name the call and the surplus positional that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]caused it.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Narrow the `+`-to-space decoding to bare colon arguments[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]decode[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]decode: apply the `+` space substitution only on the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]whitespace-delimited bare colon argument form, so `C++` in prose, quoted[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]values, and text blocks stop being corrupted.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust core parity for the shared argument grammar[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]rust[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar, decode[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rust: mirror the text-block closing rule and the narrowed `+` decoding [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in the sase-core editor and agent-launch argument scanners, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reconcile their divergent dialects against one shared corpus.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]End-to-end regression coverage and documentation[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]regression[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar, shorthand, diagnostic, decode, rust[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]regression: add a launch-level regression test built from the real [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failing prompt, add a shared cross-language corpus, and update the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]xprompt grammar documentation.[/#D7D7AF]
